policy_detail: First two fights: identical existing intent-aware selector. Boss immediate-damage: damage then normal count then lowest ID. Boss intent-aware: lethal first, then active unlatched qualifying plan, then same damage score. Boss avoid-intent: diagnostic deliberately prefers nonmitigating legal clear when available, even over lethal; otherwise same damage score. Common existing max-connection skill and shop handling.
restrictions: no recolor, favorable fixture, forced charge, HP injection, board rescue or intermediate reset
rng_parity: same game RNG; fourteen burst draws per unique actually removed ID before refill; visual effect RNG unused
